requirements.network: prepare downloads decomp-toolkit (dtk) from GitHub once

inputs.label: Medal of Honor: Frontline disc
inputs.help: A disc image you made from your own copy, or a disc you extracted with Dolphin (the folder holding sys and files).

options.label: Print performance stats to the console

stages.label: Extracting the font and memory card icon
Copying your disc into the app

saves.note: Saves stay on the Apple TV: in the app's caches, with a backup in its settings that brings them back if tvOS clears the caches. Deleting the app deletes them.

diagnose.message: The app was built without the game image. Build it again.

diagnose.match: frontline: can't load the game image
diagnose.message: tvOS refused to load the game image, usually because it was signed by a different team than the app. Build it again.

diagnose.match: frontline: audio output: no audio session
diagnose.message: The Apple TV gave the game no sound output. The game kept running without sound.
